dialogues.speaker: Sahar
dialogues.text: Hi there, are you a traveler here to shop at the Grand Bazaar? I suggest you go to Jut's shop.

dialogues.speaker: Sahar
dialogues.text: In Sumeru, spices are a must-buy, and Jut's is the best spice store you can find around.

dialogues.speaker: Sahar
dialogues.text: Not only is the quality high, but the prices are very reasonable. He even sells the rare Padisarah!

dialogues.speaker: Sahar
dialogues.text: He also gives customers small gifts on occasion, so you definitely don't want to miss his store when you come to the Grand Bazaar.

dialogues.speaker: Sahar
dialogues.text: You're welcome. I'm sure you'll love it there.
